metadata.description: General-purpose Claude Code plugin marketplace: skill-authoring and TDD skills mirrored from Matt Pocock, LSP/code-intelligence for C/C++/Objective-C and Python, an official MATLAB MCP integration, and the official Context7, GitHub, and code-review plugins.

plugins.name: mattpocock-skill-creator
plugins.description: Reference for writing skills, AGENTS.md, and CLAUDE.md (mirrored from Matt Pocock's writing-for-agents skill).

plugins.name: mattpocock-tdd
plugins.description: Test-driven development: red-green loop, seams, and test anti-patterns (mirrored from Matt Pocock's tdd skill).

plugins.name: matlab-mcp
plugins.description: Run and analyze MATLAB code via MathWorks' official MATLAB MCP Server.

plugins.name: context7
plugins.description: Up-to-date, version-specific library documentation via Upstash's Context7 MCP server (mirrored from anthropics/claude-plugins-official).

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: GitHub repository, issue, and PR management via GitHub's official MCP server (mirrored from anthropics/claude-plugins-official).

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Automated multi-agent code review with confidence-based scoring (mirrored from anthropics/claude-plugins-official).
